'''Dag Coplin''' is an [[Emond's Field]] resident.

==Appearance==
He is an old man with wrinkled skin and gray hair.

== Activities ==
When shearing sheep, [[Loise al'Vere]] argues with Dag about the proper method of shearing. He rides with Lord [[Slayer#Luc Mantear|Luc]] when Luc is antagonizing the [[Children of the Light|Whitecloaks]].
